description: Published pooled estimates the evidence-v2 pool is benchmarked against (docs/EVIDENCE_METHOD.md §3 stage 8, §8 Phase 2/4). Every row carries a VERBATIM quote cut programmatically from the Europe PMC abstract, PMC full text or PMC table (whitespace normalised); `scripts/benchmark_v2.py verify` re-fetches each source and checks the quote is in it and every number is in the quote. Values are never typed from memory (invariant 5). A benchmark is compared like for like only: SMD with our SMD, a mean difference with our natural-unit pool in the same unit (pipeline/benchmark.py).

excluded.reason: systematic review WITHOUT a meta-analysis (vote count: '3/11 studies showed an improvement'). The three pooled estimates attributed to it in scripts/experiments/vote_counting_investigation.py PUBLISHED are not in its text; two (CMJ 2.70 cm, Wingate 71.27 W) are 10.3389/fnut.2026.1800546's, now rows cr-pow-ym-*; the third (exercise_endurance SMD 0.05 [-0.26, 0.36]) was found in none of the 12 sources.
pooled WMDs published with p-values only, no CI: not benchmarkable by CI overlap.
the Europe PMC abstract says CMJ 2.87 cm, the full text and its GRADE table 2.70 cm [0.18, 5.21]; the full text is used.
